description: This file contains data classes and parsing functions related to handling invoke error messages, including parsing error codes and messages from raw strings or Throwable objects.

classes.name: ParsedInvokeError
classes.description: A data class representing a structured invoke error with code, message, and a flag indicating if the code was explicitly provided.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorMessage
methods.description: Parses a raw error message string to extract an error code and message, returning a ParsedInvokeError object.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Extracts and parses an error message from a Throwable object, providing a fallback message if necessary.
